title: mxv/up/v1
description: The selected processes and their dependencies, in the order they started, each running.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

ProcessRow.description:
One process of a workspace, as `up`, `down`, `restart` and `status`
print it.

code.description:
The exit code of an exited process, or null when a signal ended it
or it has not exited.

log.description: The process's log file, which `mxv logs` prints.

name.description: The process's name in the manifest.

pid.description:
The process id, which is also its process group's id, while it
runs.

ports.description: The ports that the process receives, as `VARIABLE=port`.

signal.description:
The number of the signal that ended an exited process, such as 15
for SIGTERM, or null.

state.description:
`running`, `exited` when it ended on its own or something other
than `mxv down` stopped it, or `stopped`.

StateName.description: The state of a process, as a row prints it.
